title: 第一个不小于 x 的数

solutions.python:
import sys
from bisect import bisect_left

data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
n, q = int(data[0]), int(data[1])
a = list(map(int, data[2:2 + n]))
out = []
for x in map(int, data[2 + n:2 + n + q]):
    pos = bisect_left(a, x)
    out.append(str(pos + 1) if pos < n else '-1')
print('\n'.join(out))

import sys
from collections import deque

data = sys.stdin.read().split()
n, m = int(data[0]), int(data[1])
g = data[2:2 + n]
dist = [[-1] * m for _ in range(n)]
q = deque()
for i in range(n):
    j = g[i].find('S')
    if j >= 0:
        dist[i][j] = 0
        q.append((i, j))
ans = -1
while q:
    x, y = q.popleft()
    if g[x][y] == 'T':
        ans = dist[x][y]
        break
    for nx, ny in ((x + 1, y), (x - 1, y), (x, y + 1), (x, y - 1)):
        if 0 <= nx < n and 0 <= ny < m and g[nx][ny] != '#' and dist[nx][ny] < 0:
            dist[nx][ny] = dist[x][y] + 1
            q.append((nx, ny))
print(ans)

import sys
from bisect import bisect_left

data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
n = int(data[0])
d = []  # d[k]：长度为 k+1 的上升子序列的最小结尾
for x in map(int, data[1:1 + n]):
    i = bisect_left(d, x)
    if i == len(d):
        d.append(x)
    else:
        d[i] = x
print(len(d))
